verdict.rationale: Founder Law presents petition work as its core paid service. Its packages are "fully managed from strategy to approval" for EB-1A/EB-1B/EB-2 NIW and cover O-1A, H-1B and similar petitions. Flat fees include USCIS filing fees, premium processing and RFE/NOID defense, and the firm stresses attorney accountability over automated form tools. Missing for 10: no explicit itemization of evidence-binder assembly, expert or support letter drafting, or form preparation; no independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end service.
